status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.restart_module_warning: Are you sure you want to restart {name}? The service will be briefly unavailable during the restart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.no_route_description: This instance has no web route, for example after a clone. Set a new host name and save.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another application
settings.host_pattern: The host name must contain a dot
settings.nginx_preset_helper: Rewrite rules of the application. nginx ignores .htaccess files.
settings.document_root_helper: Subdirectory of /app served by nginx, like public. Leave empty to serve /app.
settings.php_eol_description: PHP 8.2 security support ends on 31 December 2026. Move the site to a newer version.
settings.size_invalid: Use a whole number of MiB
settings.php_max_execution_time_invalid: Use a number of seconds between 1 and 3600
settings.database_info_description: PHP reads them in the LEMP_DB_* variables. The name and user cannot change after the first save.
settings.db_name_invalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, 64 characters at most
settings.db_user_invalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, 32 characters at most. root, admin and mysql are reserved.
settings.db_password_too_weak: The database password is too weak
settings.db_password_invalid: The password cannot contain a line break
settings.admin_account_info_description: The admin account has all rights on every database. Use it in phpMyAdmin to manage the databases.
settings.admin_password_too_weak: The admin password is too weak
settings.admin_password_invalid: The password cannot contain a line break
settings.no_user_domain_description: Create a user domain to give its LDAP credentials to the site.
settings.ldap_credentials_tooltip: PHP reads the bind credentials of the domain in the LEMP_LDAP_* variables, like ns8-lamp
settings.user_domain_not_found: The user domain does not exist
settings.smarthost_disabled_description: PHP mail() needs the cluster smarthost.
settings.mail_from_helper: Default sender of mail() messages. Leave empty for noreply@<host>.
settings.custom_files_description: Add your own settings in these files: nginx/custom.d/*.conf, php/php.d/90-custom.ini, php/fpm.d/90-custom.conf, mariadb/90-custom.cnf and crontab. They are under the state directory of {instance}, loaded after the module settings, tested before each restart and kept in backups.
settings.php_memory_limit_too_low: The memory limit must be larger than the upload size limit
settings.php_memory_limit_out_of_range: Use a memory limit between 128 and 4096 MiB
settings.php_upload_max_filesize_out_of_range: Use an upload size limit between 2 and 2048 MiB
